svg.text: 🏠 Home > 📰 Blog > 🩺 Blood Donation > Complete Guide to Blood Donation
Learn about the life-saving impact of blood donation, eligibility criteria,
and the donation process that could save multiple lives in your community.
Blood donation is one of the most valuable contributions you can make to your community.
Every donation can save up to three lives, and with consistent donations, you become
a crucial part of the healthcare system that keeps our hospitals and clinics running.
• 1 donation = 3 lives saved • Every 2 seconds someone needs blood
• Only 3% of eligible people donate • 85% of us will need blood at some point
• Blood cannot be manufactured - only comes from generous donors like you
Blood donation eligibility requirements ensure both donor safety and recipient protection.
Here are the general criteria for blood donation:
✅ Age: 18-65 years (some locations allow 16-17 with parental consent)
✅ Weight: Minimum 50kg (110 lbs) to ensure donor safety
✅ Health: Good general health with no acute illness
✅ Hemoglobin: Adequate levels (varies by gender and location)
✅ Time gap: At least 8 weeks between whole blood donations
Understanding what happens during blood donation helps ease any concerns and prepares
you for a smooth, safe experience.
Beyond helping others, blood donation offers several health benefits for donors:
Regular donation may reduce risk of heart
disease and help maintain healthy iron levels
Every donation includes free tests for
diseases like HIV, Hepatitis B and C.
that improves mood and reduces stress.
Find a blood donation center near you and schedule your appointment today!
